Container.Name: DashDen
Container.Overview: The family dashboard: profiles, Tinyauth sign-in, a Settings screen, den app widgets, a notice board and kiosk mode. Put dynacat.yml in the config folder before the first start. Secrets can be added later in Settings, which saves them in the config folder.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port DashDen listens on. Point your reverse proxy (with Tinyauth in front) here.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Holds dynacat.yml, any included files, and the secrets and history saved from Settings.

Config.Name: Assets
Config.Description: Images, custom CSS and the SQLite database (to-do lists, notice board, profiles).

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Optional. Set to /var/run/docker.sock to use the Docker containers widget.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as. 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as. 100 is Unraid's users.

Config.Name: Local time
Config.Description: Uses the server's time zone for clocks, calendars and seasonal themes.

Config.Name: Enable editor and Settings
Config.Description: true turns on the page editor and the Settings screen.

Config.Name: Recovery code
Config.Description: Optional, 16+ characters. Lets you into Settings at /settings/recover if you lock yourself out.
